translations.translatedText: # Radio Clear News Wednesday 19.7.2023
Estonia. Forest fires in Europe. Dogs. Berries. Weather.
## Estonia

![Car ferry Estonia in port, with its bow visor raised above the car deck. ](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1024,h_576,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-106268763ce46cf509be/1681827344)
Open image viewer
Car ferry Estonia in port, with its bow visor raised above the car deck. Photo: Li Samuelson / EPA
Estonian and Swedish authorities are investigating the wreck of the Estonia ship.
The Estonia's bow ramp will be lifted up from the sea for studies. The car deck of the Estonia will also be examined. This work will be done by robots that are steered to the bottom of the sea.
The Estonia sank in the Baltic Sea in September 1994. 852 people died in the accident. Researchers want to know more about what caused the accident.
## Forest fires in Europe

![A forest fire rages next to a house in Saronida, near Athens.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6016,h_3384,x_0,y_71/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-114426464b67b1b7df5b/1689680802)
Open image viewer
A forest fire rages next to a house in Saronida, near Athens. Photo: Nicolas Koutsokostas/NurPhoto/Shutterstock/All Over Press

There are forest fires in many countries in Europe. In Greece the forest has been burning for 3 days already. Hundreds of people have left their homes, and dozens of homes have been destroyed because of the fires.

There are also forest fires in Turkey and in the Swiss Alps. A forest fire starts easily because it is hot in Southern Europe and the land is dry. The weather in Southern Europe is very hot at least until the end of this week. Because of this, new forest fires may still start.
## Dog smuggling
![Two dogs with big ears.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1919,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-114418964b66f7c95b4b/1689777903)
Open image viewer
Dogs are brought into Finland from abroad without a permit. Illustrative image. Photo: Kari Kosonen / Yle
Dogs are brought into Finland from abroad without a permit. Customs says that dogs have been brought into Finland from many European countries.

A person living in Pirkanmaa has sold dogs online to different parts of Finland. Customs suspects the person of smuggling, aggravated tax fraud and aggravated bookkeeping offence. Customs suspects that the dog smuggler has received 200,000 euros in money through crimes.
Customs reminds that the person buying a dog must check carefully where the dog was born. The dog must have different certificates, for example a vaccination certificate.
## Berries
![Cloudberries.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4031,h_2268,x_0,y_156/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-113791664a3eb345b92f/1688464209)
Open image viewer
The cloudberry harvest is average at best. Photo: Anja Kaarret / Yle

Bilberries and cloudberries are not doing very well this year. The Natural Resources Institute says that this year there may be an average amount of berries or less than average. For berries it was a bad thing that in spring the weather was cold on many nights.
Instead, there may be a lot of lingonberries this year.
## Weather

![Weather maps from Thursday to Saturday. 20.7. - 21.7.2023.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1919,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-114474664b7d85c4addc/1689770109)
Open image viewer
Photo: Matti Huutonen / Yle
In many places it rains on Thursday. In the middle of the country it rains only a little.
The night temperature is mostly 10 to 15 degrees. On Thursday in the daytime the temperature is 15 to 22 degrees, in Northern Lapland it is cooler.
A forest fire warning is in force in many places in Southern Finland. In Lapland there are warnings of heavy thunderstorms.
